# Developer credential references that are metadata, configuration names,
# documentation, paths or protected-store references rather than credentials.

# Cargo paths, registry names and helper configuration.
cargo_credentials_path=~/.cargo/credentials.toml
cargo_config_path=~/.cargo/config.toml
cargo_registry=crates-io
cargo_registry_name=internal
credential_provider=cargo:token
credential_provider=cargo:libsecret
credential_provider=cargo:macos-keychain
credential_provider=cargo:wincred
credential_alias=registry-token

# Cargo environment-variable names without assigned credential material.
required_env=CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN
forward_env=CARGO_REGISTRIES_INTERNAL_TOKEN
example="export CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN=<token>"

# PyPI / twine configuration references.
pypirc_path=~/.pypirc
repository_name=pypi
repository_name=testpypi
repository_url=https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/
repository_url=https://test.pypi.org/legacy/
username_hint=__token__
example="password = <your-token>"

# RubyGems paths, environment names and credential-store references.
rubygems_credentials_path=~/.gem/credentials
rubygems_config_path=~/.gemrc
required_env=GEM_HOST_API_KEY
helper_name=gem_push_key
example="GEM_HOST_API_KEY=<api-key>"

# NuGet paths, source names and protected credential references.
nuget_config_path=~/.nuget/NuGet/NuGet.Config
package_source=PrivateFeed
package_source=https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json
credential_field=ClearTextPassword
protected_field=Password
credential_store=NuGet.Config
example="dotnet nuget add source <source> --username <user> --password <password>"

# Maven paths, server IDs and protected-password references.
maven_settings_path=~/.m2/settings.xml
maven_security_settings_path=~/.m2/settings-security.xml
server_id=internal-repository
repository_id=central
repository_url=https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2
credential_element=password
protected_password="{encrypted-password}"
example="<password>your_password_here</password>"

# Generic OS/external credential-store references.
credential_store=Keychain
credential_store=macOS Keychain
credential_store=Windows Credential Manager
credential_store=Secret Service
credential_store=libsecret
credential_store=keyring
credential_store=1Password
credential_store=Vault

# Helper/function/type names are identifiers, not credential material.
helper=load_registry_token
helper=read_registry_password
helper=get_package_credentials
helper=resolve_maven_password
helper=nuget_credentials
helper=rubygems_api_key
type=PasswordCredentials
type=HttpHeaderCredentials
type=AwsCredentials
function=getCredentials
function=credentialProvider
